items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1972-05-27
items.q: I would go up there and sit down with Amanda Perez... I have always been able to make friends on the spur of the moment.

ctx.x: Did you play on that street?

Sure, I played. It was an old hall called the Frans Amie Hall which is about a block, a full block from where I was born. And I used to love to go there because I'd climb up the steps and go to the bands used to play up the stairs that weren't in the pianos. And I would go up there and sit down with Amanda Perez and sometimes it'd be Chris Kelly or all the new railroad runners. Whatever band was there, I was able to get in because everybody knew me and called me but I was this little fella down with the little…
Have you ever been shy in your life?
